The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified: Shared with reborn-plan-m13-classes-1800, whose prespecification applies unchanged; this file only plays one tier of its starts. Fixed 2026-11-16, before any result was read; follows rs-kit-trip-development. Descriptive development study. Primary endpoint: fewer natural deaths first. Then mean final character level, mean deepest level and the DL5+ count, including dead characters. Every result is reported per class, because the plan differs by class. Paired rescued and newly killed counts against reborn-m13-control for each arm. Factorial effects: plan, town planner and plan x town planner. Incomplete, config_error and borg_stopped cells are reported separately. Nothing here confirms a winner; that needs a fresh confirmation suite. Amended 2026-11-16, before any result of this experiment was read. (1) Source: borg-reborn-rs 8a0b57c85700abd48981c2f41a65a0a637f7dc48 (#415), source-hash rust 9a4ea3756fb1b566..., a different game from 2f74e1c5 and 1c4b351b (87717140...). Its vendored core is borg-rs 8c5d000a, with borg-rs#92's per-visit Home guard (the borg-rs#90 oil loop fix) and borg-rs#88's additive trip policy. harness/borg.txt is 88296dd1..., with the same settings as before. Plans: errands_plan.txt 922372ba..., errands_plan_ambitious.txt 9d7d8a39.... (2) Arms: reborn-m13-control, reborn-m13-town, reborn-m13-plan, reborn-m13-plan-town and reborn-m13-ambitious-town. 'Shop' here is the live town planner only (borg_town_plan = 1, borg_trip_policy = 0), so #88's trip policy is not part of this study; whether it belongs is tested separately (reborn-trip-3x3-classes-18). The town-planner arms include #92's Home guard. Control and plan play as on 1c4b351b (byte-identical keys, checked by the zoo and by borg-reborn-rs). Earlier shop-arm results (zoo pilots 43845673921 and 43851628610, borg-reborn-rs's local 72-game pilot) had the oil loop and the trip policy on, and are not comparable. (3) A fifth arm, reborn-m13-ambitious-town, is compared with reborn-m13-control and with reborn-m13-plan-town (paired rescued and newly killed counts, per class); it is outside the 2x2. (4) The plan in force is evidenced by the core's copy of the loaded plan (errands_plan.txt in the cell's output directory): its sha256 must equal the requested plan's, and it must be absent in no-plan arms, or the cell is config_error. (5) Stalls: a cell with 1,000 or more keys at one game turn is stalled (frozen_turn_loop), with its observed outcome kept. A cell with more than 3 times its arm's median keys (over the arm's turn-cap cells) is flagged key_outlier, because #92 guards one Home visit only and a store/take across visits is still possible, though it costs game time. Flagged cells are listed, and the primary endpoint is reported with and without them. (6) Dispatch on 8 shards; 9,000 cells on 4 would come close to the run job's 300-minute limit. Tiers (RULES 14, fixed 2026-11-16 before any tier result was read): small, medium, big and full play classes-1800 starts 1-90, 91-360, 361-900 and 901-1800. Gate before medium: every one of the 450 cells has a valid outcome (death, turn_cap or borg_stopped) or a listed, explained stall; no config_error; every plan cell's loaded-plan copy matches its pin and no no-plan cell has one; each stall and key outlier is listed with its cause; measured wall time per cell is recorded.
